description: See who cites a research paper and what it cites, using OpenCitations' open index of scholarly citations. Count a work's citations and references or a journal's citations, spot author and journal self-citations, get a work's title, authors, journal and date from its DOI, PubMed ID or OpenAlex ID, list an author's or editor's works by ORCID iD, and find works by title. No account or API key required.
